items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: I was MC. When I went and took over the band, Tiny Joe was out.

ctx.x: I went to the California. Yeah. And played with these boys, Dinah, Dinah, Dinah, Joy had booked in there, see. But after you left there, where'd you went? Well, no. Went to New Mexico? Yeah. Went to Hobbs? Yeah, I worked there, oh yeah. I worked there for about a year though for a joint this time. Did you? Oh yeah. I was MC. When I went and took over the band, Tiny Joe was out. I see. See?
That's how Joe did MC'ing too, huh?
